svg.title: chunkwise
svg.desc: Chunkwise form on 16 toy tokens in chunks of 4. Inside each chunk, the diagonal block is a small masked attention. Everything below the diagonal blocks comes from the state carried from earlier chunks; the state is updated once per chunk.
